notes: Add a config option for the 'type' field name; when set, type becomes mandatory on every task. Define a schema per type, enforced on creation and mutation. OPEN QUESTION: how to handle existing tasks that no longer match their schema after an update (reject / flag / grandfather?).
title: Per-type schemas: mandatory type field + validation on create/update

notes: New 'Append' op that adds to an existing field instead of read-modify-write (e.g. running notes/comments log). Merge bonus: two concurrent appends to the same field are conflict-free — they accumulate, unlike Update which contends. OPEN: field representation (list of entries vs delimited text), and how materialize + compaction fold a sequence of appends.
title: Append mutations: accumulate notes/comments without overwriting a field

notes: Open the task's current fields (and deps) in $EDITOR/$VISUAL (fallback vi/nano), git-commit style; on save, diff against current state and emit minimal mutations (Update for changed/added fields, AddDep/RemoveDep for dep changes). Add 'ed' as an alias. OPEN: removing a field has no op today (Update only sets, never unsets) — needs a field-delete op or removals are ignored; also decide the on-disk edit format (TOML/JSON/key=value).
title: 'edit'/'ed' command: edit a task manually in $EDITOR

notes: Current search only exact-matches a single field, which is unusable. Support (1) multiple criteria AND-combined, e.g. 'status~open priority=3', and (2) per-field regex matching. Decide operator syntax (exact '=' vs regex '~' vs negation), how to match non-string JSON values, and whether to query deps too. Likely adds the 'regex' crate.
title: Improve search: per-field regex + multiple combined criteria

notes: Today list/search/ready dump raw field JSON. Add (1) user-configurable column set and order (config default, e.g. a [display] columns=[...] section, overridable per-command); (2) --all to print every field; (3) --format with human (default, aligned table) and json (full machine-readable task objects, ideal for agents). Apply uniformly across the three listing commands. Decide human layout and long-field truncation.
title: Configurable output for list/search/ready: columns, --all, --format json

notes: Command to upgrade the installed binary to the newest release, e.g. by shelling out to 'cargo install taska', or the self_update crate for GitHub-release binaries. NAME COLLISION: 'update' is already the task-field update command, so call this 'upgrade' or 'self-update'. Consider reporting current vs latest version (crates.io), and gracefully handling installs not done via cargo.
title: Self-update command: update ta to the latest published version

notes: git-config-style command to view and change .taska/config.toml without hand-editing, using dotted keys (compaction.keep_events, workflow.status_field, merge.on_conflict). Subcommands: get / set / list. Validate on set (reuse Config::validate — reject keep_events<100, invalid on_conflict, etc.). Preserve the documented comments when rewriting (consider the toml_edit crate instead of plain re-serialization).
title: 'config' command: get/set/list config options from the CLI

notes: Generalize the single dependency edge into typed relationships. Default types: subtask_of, depends_on, relates_to, duplicates; user-configurable (define custom types in config). Model: AddDep/RemoveDep gain a 'type' (default depends_on for back-compat) and TaskState stores typed edges instead of a flat depends_on list. Semantics differ per type: depends_on blocks 'ready' and must be acyclic; subtask_of is a hierarchy (acyclic, possible rollup); relates_to and duplicates are informational and likely symmetric (cycles irrelevant). Decide per-type properties (blocking? acyclic? symmetric?), CLI surface (extend block/unblock or add a 'link' command), and migration of existing edges.
title: Typed relationships: subtask_of / depends_on / relates_to / duplicates (configurable)

notes: Add 'ta status' printing an aggregate summary like beads (Total / per-status / Blocked / Closed / Ready to Work). Schema-agnostic twist: status values are user-defined, so don't hardcode Open/In Progress/Closed — group dynamically by the actual status_field values present, with done_status as the done/closed bucket. Blocked and Ready are COMPUTED, not status values: Blocked = has a dependency that isn't done; Ready = reuse the 'ready' set. Decide output ordering and column alignment.
title: 'status' command: summary counts (total, by status, blocked, ready)

notes: Default WorkflowConfig.done_status is 'done'; change the out-of-box default to 'closed' (aligns with the open/closed issue-tracker convention and the status-command summary). Touches config defaults, default_toml, and tests. RELEASE NOTE: it's a behavior change, so bump the version; only affects NEW stores — existing ones keep the done_status already written into their config.toml at init.
title: Change default done_status from 'done' to 'closed'
